name: stillscribe
description: YouTube 视频 → 图文文章 桌面应用（monorepo 根）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,ui -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:engine" "pnpm dev:ui" "pnpm dev:desktop"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @stillscribe/engine typecheck && pnpm --filter @stillscribe/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @stillscribe/desktop typecheck
